interpretation.hardIntegrityFlags: Machine-verifiable structural, binding, provenance, or hash failures.
interpretation.provenanceCompletenessFlags: Missing fields from older public schemas. These require evidence reconstruction but are not automatically integrity failures.
interpretation.reviewFlags: Risk indicators requiring human substantive review; they are not findings that a public claim is false.
interpretation.duplicateFlags: Exact identity or content clusters; independent propositions from one work are not treated as duplicates merely because they share a work URL.
interpretation.remediation: All actions are proposed only. Publication freeze prohibits public mutation.
